subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold entry-point launch/session behavior into the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam?
rationale: This choice defines a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and browser isolation contract; automation can flag unsafe fallbacks, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and trust model before third-party plugins depend on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed under one public UI-page seam.

options.title: Approve Separate Entry API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but require iframe-only opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave this PR open but do not merge until the broader Control UI contribution issue and RFC settle native plugin page semantics.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior and keep plugin pages sandboxed under one public UI-page seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the generic plugin host-hook foundation and the related Control UI contribution RFC, so their history best matches the API-shape decision.
